{{Quote|Always better over the water!|Paddy Accu, to Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Paddy Accu''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. As a young man, Accu was a respected pilot and warrior in [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. Upon retiring from active duty, he served the Royal House of Naboo as the official boatman of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]]. He later took on the position of caretaker at the [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] island, in the Nabooan [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]], working for the [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]]. When [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], née Naberrie, returned to Naboo after an assassination attempt in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Accu took the senator and her secret lover [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to the Varykino.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Don't tell me you've forgotten!''"<br />"''Oh, yes! I do remember!|Paddy Accu and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="AOCn" />}}
[[File:Lake_country_palmtree.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Lake Country, Paddy Accu's home region]]
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] named Paddy Accu [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a bountiful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As a child, Accu developed a passion for boating, which he could exercise freely in his native [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]]. Some time later, he went on to serve in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Like many of his fellow Security Forces members, he worked with the [[Sector/Legends|sectorial]] forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FF87" />

When Accu retired from the Security Forces, he continued to serve the royalty by joining the staff working at the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. In that new capacity, the man would fly major public figures, including royal family members and important [[Politics/Legends|politicians]]. He also reconnected with his boyhood passion upon becoming the Palace's boatman.<ref name="FF87" />

===Caretaker of the Lake Retreat===
{{Quote|I'll bring the bags up for you. You go and see what you can see&mdash;don't want to be wasting your time on the little chores!|Paddy Accu, to Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOCn" />}}
Eventually, Accu decided to leave public service for good, although he did not stop working entirely. He was hired by the [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]], whose member charged him with taking care of their summer residence on the [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] island. As Varykino was located in the middle of a lake in his native region, Accu was glad to accept his new employment. When the Naberries made trips to their estate in the summer, the former soldier would often pilot the boats or speeders for the family's youngest daughter, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]].<ref name="FF87" /> Under the name of Amidala, the girl ended up becoming [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], at age thirteen,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and Accu retained fond memories of taking her on thrilling rides in his [[Gondola Speeder/Legends|gondola speeder]] back when she was a child.<ref name="FF87" />

[[File:Gondolaspeeder.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Accu helping Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala depart from his gondola speeder]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Amidala&mdash;now a [[Senator/Legends|representative]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]&mdash;returned to the Varykino estate with her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] protector, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] following an assassination attempt on her person. Accu drove the wave-riding gondola speeder that brought Amidala and Skywalker to the lake retreat.<ref name="AOC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Seeing that the senator enjoyed the ride like she used to, Accu made sure to take his time reaching the estate's shore. After the boat made it to its destination, Accu helped Amidala and her protector unload their baggage.<ref name="AOC" /> When Skywalker decided to travel to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Accu again transported the pair to a landing pad where the Senator's [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|H-type Nubian yacht]] was docked.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It was&hellip; fun.''"<br />"''If it isn't, then what's the point?|Anakin Skywalker and Paddy Accu|<ref name="AOCn" />}}
By 22 BBY, Paddy Accu was an older, light-skinned man with [[Color/Legends|graying]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. Although he appeared surly to strangers,<ref name="AOCn" /> he was a loyal<ref name="FF87" /> and helpful man. He liked to share his passion for boating with those he transported aboard his gondola speeder. When riding wildly across the water, he would show his easy-going side, laughing mischievously all the way.<ref name="AOCn" /> When Amidala and Skywalker visited Varykino, Accu wore a lilac shirt with a laced neck and a folded over collar, a pair of blue pants and a dark, sleeveless vest.<ref name="FF87" />

==Behind the scenes==
Paddy is only seen very briefly in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], helping to unpack suitcases from a gondola at Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] home in the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]].
